resources.string: Every tape is different. Start gently and compare with the original while the music keeps playing.
Rumble reduces very low bass. Clarity also softens low-mid buildup and adds a little presence.

Applies to streaming and downloaded music. Your saved recordings stay unchanged.\n\nThis is gentle tone correction. It cannot recover detail lost to distortion or reliably remove the crowd. Clarity may sound slightly quieter; louder is not always better.
